riley (eng-docs): node snippet (KMS salt):
```js
// pseudonymize using KMS-derived salt (illustrative)
const crypto = require('crypto');
async function pseudonymize(userId, kmsSalt) {
  const h = crypto.createHmac('sha256', kmsSalt).update(userId).digest('hex');
  return h.slice(0, 24);
}
```
